text:
So little does your light shoe weigh

that it pretends, when your foot rests,

to be, more than a shoe, a rose petal

made to tread on flakes of snow.

If an agile orchestra moves its measures

and you give yourself joyfully to the dance,

the turn of your brief sole

seems to alight upon a butterfly.

With what nervous gait did it guide

the exquisite, unfaithful anguish of your first rendezvous?


What secrets of love have enchanted it?

Satin boat in which your foot sails,

it led you, unbridled and blind,

to the Cythera of the first sin.

translation.title: Your Shoe
translation.editorial_note: The ornate shoe conceit is kept as a sonnet-like miniature, with Cythera preserving the erotic classical allusion.
